title: 老爹鞋被Z世代穿火：新百伦年销92亿，距百亿目标还差多少？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: That was the ambitious sales goal that the CEO of New Balance, Joe Preston, set for 2026.
segments.zh: 这是新百伦CEO乔·普雷斯顿为2026年设定的雄心勃勃的销售目标。

segments.en: But with the consumer increasingly under pressure, the sneaker company has some ground to make up.
segments.zh: 但随着消费者日益承压，这家运动鞋公司还需努力追赶。

segments.en: We're not there yet. Obviously we're through three quarters. And this year has been a little bit more challenging.
segments.zh: 我们还没达到。显然已过了三个季度，今年更具挑战性。

segments.en: We will definitely grow. But the market place is a little bit muddy.
segments.zh: 我们肯定会增长，但市场有些浑浊。

segments.en: There's no question about it. Rising prices, dwindling savings, slowing wage growth, all-waying on shoppers, all at a time when the footwear industry is growing more crowded and more competitive.
segments.zh: 毫无疑问，价格上涨、储蓄减少、工资增长放缓，都在影响购物者，而鞋类行业竞争日益激烈。

segments.en: It's been super competitive since I've been in the industry.
segments.zh: 自从我进入这个行业以来，竞争一直非常激烈。

segments.en: I mean, each and every year there is a number of brands that compete in this base.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，每年都有许多品牌在这个领域竞争。

segments.en: But Boston-based New Balance says it has an answer for how to stand out in the pack.
segments.zh: 但总部位于波士顿的新百伦表示，它有办法在竞争中脱颖而出。

segments.en: We wanted to make a commitment to get younger. And what better way to appeal to the youth than with the shoe most associated with middle age, middle
segments.zh: 我们想致力于年轻化。还有什么比用最与中年关联的鞋来吸引年轻人更好的方式呢？

segments.en: American dads? The New Balance 990s, a high performance running shoe introduced in 1982, earned the affectionate
segments.zh: 美国老爸们？新百伦 990s，一款1982年推出的高性能跑鞋，赢得了

segments.en: nickname the dad shoe because of its norm-core styling and orthopedic comfort that made it a hit with older consumers.
segments.zh: “老爸鞋”的昵称，因为它的 norm-core 风格和骨科般的舒适感让它深受年长消费者喜爱。

segments.en: It's now a hit with Gen Z, an influx of celebs, influencers and runway models all sporting the look and the payoff for New Balance?
segments.zh: 如今它深受 Z 世代欢迎，名人、网红和 T 台模特纷纷穿上这双鞋，新百伦 的回报是？

segments.en: Five consecutive years of double-digit growth, notching $9.2 billion in annual sales in 2025.
segments.zh: 连续五年实现两位数增长，2025 年年度销售额达到 92 亿美元。
